player_0.content: New plan: I got stuck in an infinite loop between the Balcony and the Home office by repeatedly choosing "north" and "south" without tracking visited rooms. The target room (Sauna) was never reached because I failed to explore the "west" direction available in the Balcony. Next time, I will maintain a mental list of visited rooms. Upon entering a room, I will check if I have been there before; if so, I will only try unvisited directions. If all directions lead to visited rooms, I will stop and declare "DONE". Specifically, from the Balcony, I should have tried "west" first to break the loop.
